prompt_text:
Match this appearance phrase against ALL anonymous person tiles in the image(s): "the person wearing a black jacket with white stripes on the sleeves and a white face mask"
Every labeled tile is one different person from the same video; its two crops are held-out views. Labels and tile order do not reveal the intended target. A phrase may match none, one, or several people. Include ALL people who visibly satisfy the whole phrase in matches. Include in uncertain any plausible person for whom the views do not resolve an attribute, instead of assuming that person is a non-match. Do not pick a best match when several fit. A location or action does not distinguish appearance. Omitted labels mean clear non-matches.
Return {"matches":["P01"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"brief visual explanation"}. Valid labels: ["P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P07", "P08", "P09"].

message.content: {"matches":["P01","P02","P03","P04","P05","P06","P07","P08","P09"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"All individuals are wearing black jackets, black pants, white sneakers, and white face masks. In most tiles, white stripes are visible on the sleeves of the jackets, particularly on the upper arms. The appearance described matches all persons across the tiles, as no one lacks the black jacket with white sleeve stripes or the white face mask. The slight motion blur in some images does not negate the presence of these features, which are consistently visible in at least one view per person."}
